items.description: Response struct for a discount with its position in a stack and optional.

business_id.description: The business this discount belongs to.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the discount was created.

cycles_remaining.description: Remaining billing cycles for this discount on this subscription (None for one-time payments).

expires_at.description: Optional date/time after which discount is expired.

metadata.description: Additional metadata.

position.description: Position of this discount in the stack (0-based).

preserve_on_plan_change.description: Whether this discount should be preserved when a subscription changes plans.

restricted_to.description: List of product IDs to which this discount is restricted.

subscription_cycles.description: Number of subscription billing cycles this discount is valid for.

times_used.description: How many times this discount has been used.

usage_limit.description: Usage limit for this discount, if any.

expires_at.description: Timestamp when the subscription will expire.

has_payment_method.description: Whether a payment method is on file. False while a card-optional.

metadata.description: Additional custom data associated with the subscription.

meter_credit_entitlement_cart.description: Meter credit entitlement cart settings for this subscription.

items.description: Response struct representing meter-credit entitlement mapping cart details for a subscription.

meters.description: Meters associated with this subscription (for usage-based billing).

items.description: Response struct representing usage-based meter cart details for a subscription.

next_billing_date.description: Timestamp of the next scheduled billing. Indicates the end of current billing period.

on_demand.description: Wether the subscription is on-demand or not.

paused_at.description: Timestamp when the subscription was paused, if it currently is (or is.

payment_frequency_interval.description: Time interval for payment frequency (e.g. month, year).

payment_method_id.description: Saved payment method id used for recurring charges.

payment_terms_days.description: Days from the invoice date to the due date. `null` for `normal`.

previous_billing_date.description: Timestamp of the last payment. Indicates the start of current billing period.

product_id.description: Identifier of the product associated with this subscription.

quantity.description: Number of units/items included in the subscription.

recurring_pre_tax_amount.description: Amount charged before tax for each recurring payment in the currency's smallest unit.

subscription_period_interval.description: Time interval for the subscription period (e.g. month, year).

tax_id.description: Tax identifier provided for this subscription (if applicable).

tax_inclusive.description: Indicates if the recurring_pre_tax_amount is tax inclusive.

trial_amount.description: Per-unit trial amount after discounts, snapshotted at subscription creation.

trial_period_days.description: Number of days in the trial period (0 if no trial).
